permissions.catalog.manage: Create and change brands, categories and products, move them to the trash and restore them.

permissions.settings.manage: Change the store's settings. Requiring two-factor authentication for staff stays with the owner.
permissions.settings.view: See the store's settings: name, country, currency, languages, tax mode, units and contact details.

permissions.staff.manage: Change staff members' roles, and deactivate or reactivate them.
permissions.staff.view: See the team: staff members, their roles and pending invitations.
permissions.stores.export: Export all of a store's data, including every customer's personal data.
permissions.stores.grant: Give stores modules and integrations outside their plan, and change their usage limits.
permissions.stores.manage: Suspend, reactivate, close and restore stores, and retry setting up a store whose setup failed.
permissions.stores.view: See every store, its status, plan, feature grants and limit overrides.
